message: Hub setup now promotes the same process to the Project Hub when Graph and Wiki are ready; the commit/restart screen is no longer the terminal UI.
Hub Overview now leads with Context, shows at most one interrupt, and keeps the waitlist last. Index readiness and Activity left Home so the first screen is a product, not a dashboard.

Restored the two-column Overview atlas. The stripped first screen was too empty: it removed Activity, context readiness, and the side rail. Context-first copy can come later without deleting the dashboard.

Overview Attention now leads with Your project memory / Open Context when Knowledge is browsable. Identity and missing indexes still take the hero slot. Relays stay queue rows. The two-column atlas, readiness, Activity, jobs, and From mex waitlist remain.
